notes.title: Update - Patch #3
notes.content:
[ General ]

- Added a new feature: Focus Pointer, which allows players to place a custom point on the screen.
- Added an option to disable chromatic aberration (only available when VHS mode is OFF.


[ Languages ]

- Added support for the following languages: Hungarian, Korean, Ukrainian, Catalan, and Polish.
- Improved translations and corrected various issues in Spanish and Russia.


[ Eternal Suburbia]  – Major Update

- Expanded the bunker and laboratory areas with new rooms and branching paths.
- Reworked suburb transitions: elevators are now located only at the end, and players must now find red doors that lead to a red hallway to travel between suburbs.
- Fixed a bug where the player’s speed would become abnormally high after exiting the first suburb.


[ Dreampools ]

- Fixed an issue where systems without dedicated GPUs were unable to render lighting properly.

notes.title: Patch #2 is Live!
notes.content:
Hey Dreamers,

We’ve just released the second patch for Dreamcore, bringing a bunch of fixes and improvements to enhance your experience. Here’s what’s new:

✅ Fixed camera zoom sounds not being affected by volume settings
✅ Fixed multiple issues with holes in the ground/walls
✅ Fixed music in the main menu pausing after changing VHS settings
✅ Keybindings are now properly saved
✅ Fixed missing collisions in Eternal Suburbia
✅ Fixed camera jumping positions when the game hitched
✅ Water now correctly stops you from running
✅ Improved performance in both intro sequences

This is just the beginning—more fixes, tweaks, and new content are on the way. Thanks for playing, and keep an eye out for future updates!

Let us know if you run into any issues, and as always, keep dreaming. ✨

notes.title: 🌀 Dreamcore Patch #1 – Bug Fixes & Improvements 🌀
notes.content:
Hey, friends of liminal spaces!

Our first patch is live! Below is the list of fixes and improvements. We're hard at work on even more updates, and we truly appreciate all the feedback—so keep it coming!

We aim to roll out patches every week or so, prioritizing the most pressing issues. If you reported a bug and don’t see it fixed yet, rest assured that we're working on it.

Thank you all for playing and for the incredible support this community has shown us. We couldn't be more thrilled! Stay tuned for more news soon.

🔧 Patch Notes:
Fixed: Default zoom level being out of focus when VHS mode was off.
Improved: Smoother transition when toggling VHS mode on/off.
Fixed: [redacted] at the start of the level in Dreampools.
Adjusted: [redacted] detection radius in Dreampools.
Tweaked: Game balance in Dreampools.
Fixed: Softlock in Eternal Suburbia where players could fall off the level.
Fixed: Invisible exterior walls on a house in Eternal Suburbia.

Let us know if you run into any more issues, and thanks again for being part of this journey! 🚀

notes.title: Final demo update and New STUDIO
notes.content:
[b]About Us[/b]

After [b]Dreamcore's[/b] success over the past several months, we have established a dedicated studio [b](Montraluz)[/b] to focus the ongoing [b]development[/b] of the game. Additionally, we have undertaken a [b]logo rebranding[/b] in conjunction with the [b]demo's final update.[/b] The [b]upcoming map[/b] development is already underway and is targeted for release in the [b]first quarter of 2024.[/b]

The final demo update includes:

[list]
[*] The logo rebranding
[*] A brand new studio intro
[*] A revamped start cinematic
[*] A final sequence
[*] A revamped UI
[*] A "Disable VHS" button
[*] An "aspect ratio" button
[*] Brightness improvements
[*] Changes in MANY rooms
[*] Increased camera shake by 15%
[*] Increased running speed by 10%
[*] Added events
[*] Added 10 soundtracks
[*] Added 10 footsteps sounds
[*] 21 languages support!
[*] Fixed A LOT of bugs (Thanks for the feedback ❤️)
[*] Something sneaky... :)
[/list]
